correctness.rationale: The proof separates rank at most one and rank two. At rank at most one all differentials of 3x3 minors vanish. At rank two, smoothness of the ambient symmetric determinantal variety reduces singularity of the linear section to a conormal intersection. The span of the two forbidden-entry conormals has a rank-4 generic element, so only the two rank-2 generators can lie in Sym^2(kernel), forcing exactly the two opposite diagonal lines. The rank-one equations factor into four coordinate lines before the Veronese map. Exact symbolic replay verifies all component containments and representative Jacobian ranks.

value.rationale: The lead paper explicitly motivates finer singularity and resolution invariants for graph/configuration hypersurfaces. The four-wheel is the smallest wheel where the second degeneracy variety is not the full generic symmetric rank locus. Computing its next singular stratum reveals two extra rank-two components caused by nontransverse linear section, a structural feature invisible from the generic rank stratification. The exact six-component K4 arrangement is a natural base case for resolution or stratified analysis of wheel graph hypersurfaces.
